d:
Kokroch janta parti (sijepi) ke sansthapak abhijit dipke ne gayak aur abhineta diljit dosanjh par tippani ke lie sarvajnik rup se mafi mangi hai. unhonne dilli men nit pepar lik ke bad hue chhatr pradarshanon ke dauran aavaz nahin uthane ko lekar diljit ki aalochna ki thi. dipke ne yah mafi shukravar sham dilli ke javaharlal nehru stediyam men apne konsart ke dauran diljit dosanjh ke is mudde par pratikriya dene ke bad mangi.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
